title: Detailed red car
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff5a5a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#c81f1f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glass' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#bfe9ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#5aa9d6'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='79' rx='40' ry='5' fill='#3a1030'/>

  <!-- body main -->
  <path d='M8 62 q0 -6 6 -7 l10 -1 q4 -14 16 -17 q10 -3 22 -3 q14 0 22 6 q5 4 7 12 l2 9 q1 6 -5 7 l-4 0 q-2 -9 -11 -9 q-9 0 -11 9 l-20 0 q-2 -9 -11 -9 q-9 0 -11 9 l-6 0 q-6 0 -6 -6 z' fill='url(#body)' stroke='#ff9a9a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- roof/hood highlights -->
  <path d='M26 44 q6 -14 18 -16 q12 -2 24 3 q9 3 12 12 l1 4 l-56 2 z' fill='#ff7a7a' opacity='0.55'/>
  <path d='M10 56 l16 -2 l2 6 l-16 1 z' fill='#ff9d9d' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- windows -->
  <path d='M35 42 q9 -11 20 -11 q10 0 18 8 l1 5 l-40 1 z' fill='url(#glass)' stroke='#e8f8ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='32' x2='52' y2='44' stroke='#e8f8ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- door line -->
  <line x1='56' y1='45' x2='56' y2='62' stroke='#ffaeae' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='61' x2='40' y2='45' stroke='#ffaeae' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- door handle -->
  <rect x='44' y='52' width='7' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#ffe28a' stroke='#fff2c0' stroke-width='0.6'/>

  <!-- headlight -->
  <path d='M8 55 q-2 4 0 7 l7 0 l1 -8 z' fill='#ffe98a' stroke='#fff6c8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M92 56 l6 -2 q2 3 0 6 l-6 0 z' fill='#ff8a3a' stroke='#ffc48a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- bumper -->
  <rect x='7' y='63' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#d9d9e8' stroke='#f4f4ff' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <rect x='80' y='63' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#d9d9e8' stroke='#f4f4ff' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='70' r='9' fill='#2b2b3c' stroke='#8a8aa8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='70' r='4' fill='#c9c9dc' stroke='#f0f0ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='70' r='9' fill='#2b2b3c' stroke='#8a8aa8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='70' r='4' fill='#c9c9dc' stroke='#f0f0ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- spokes hint -->
  <g stroke='#6f6f92' stroke-width='1'>
    <line x1='26' y1='66' x2='26' y2='74'/>
    <line x1='22' y1='70' x2='30' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='72' y1='66' x2='72' y2='74'/>
    <line x1='68' y1='70' x2='76' y2='70'/>
  </g>

  <!-- side mirror -->
  <rect x='58' y='44' width='5' height='3.5' rx='1.5' fill='#ff4a4a' stroke='#ffb0b0' stroke-width='0.7'/>
</svg>
